subject: Vendor setup checklist & purchase channel confirmation
messages:
From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@atlasanalytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@atlasanalytics.com>, Ben Daly <ben.daly@atlasanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-04-27T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor setup + next steps for Redwood

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the demo earlier — Atlas liked the throughput numbers. Procurement is starting the vendor setup and we want to make sure we route through the right commercial path. Quick questions so we can spin up the paperwork on our side: 

- Do you have a standard procurement intake packet (W-9, vendor profile, banking details) we can upload to our vendor portal?
- Is Redwood able to accept a PO (net 30) or is card payment required for initial invoices? We may do a mix, so need to confirm both options.
- Does Redwood list on AWS Marketplace? If yes, any additional steps to enable marketplace purchases?

We have an internal vendor portal (link below) that prefers PDF forms. Goal is to have vendor created this week so finance can issue the PO.

Portal: https://atlasanalytics.procurementportal.com/vendor-setup?id=AA-9876

Attaching a blank vendor-setup checklist from our side (we'll send the PO after setup). Let me know what you need from us.

Thanks,
Alicia Torres
Head of Vendor Ops
Atlas Analytics
procurement@atlasanalytics.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-27T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + next steps for Redwood

Hi Alicia — great to hear Atlas is moving forward and thank you for the quick follow up. Summary and next steps below so procurement has everything in one place.

Summary / what we can provide today:
- Redwood procurement packet (attached): includes vendor profile, Redwood_W-9.pdf, and our bank details stub.
- Payment methods: we accept PO (Net 30) and corporate card. For new customers we typically invoice against a PO; card can be used for a one-off initial payment if procurement prefers immediate charge.
- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace (private listing for some enterprise accounts). If Atlas wants to purchase via Marketplace we can enable entitlement — that path has additional procurement paperwork and can add ~2 business days to onboarding.

Requested from Atlas:
- Confirm preferred commercial path: PO (Net 30) OR Marketplace OR card. If PO: confirm billing contact and whether Atlas requires a tax form beyond W-9.
- If you upload files to your portal, please share the portal confirmation or vendor ID so our accounting team can match.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I attach the Redwood_Procurement_Intake.pdf and Redwood_W-9.pdf — please upload to your portal.
2) Monica (cc'd) will follow up on billing details and send a sample commercial invoice if PO is selected.
3) Grace (cc'd) will review any marketplace contract language if you opt for Marketplace purchase.

Attachments: Redwood_Procurement_Intake.pdf, Redwood_W-9.pdf

Happy to jump on a 15-minute call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0102

Hi Alicia — Monica here from Redwood finance. A couple quick clarifying items so we can align with your vendor intake: 

- PO details: if Atlas issues a PO, we'll need a PO number and billing address. Our default payment terms for PO are Net 30 but we can accommodate Net 45 subject to account review. Please let us know which term Atlas will issue.
- Bank details: Marcus attached a bank stub; we can provide a full wire instruction letter through a secure DocuSign if you prefer not to transmit banking info via portal upload.
- Tax form: W-9 is fine for US entities. If Atlas is asking for W-8BEN or additional forms, flag that and we'll route to tax.

If you confirm PO + Net 30, we'll prepare a commercial invoice and a sample statement for your AP team to match.

Thanks — copying Grace for Marketplace-related coordination.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Marcus and Monica — quick update from procurement: 

- Atlas will proceed with a PO (Net 30). We will create the vendor record today and provide a vendor ID once uploaded.
- I uploaded your Redwood_Procurement_Intake.pdf and Redwood_W-9.pdf to our portal (see confirmation link). Please confirm once you see the vendor ID so we can match the incoming PO.
- Marketplace: we will not use AWS Marketplace for this initial purchase — PO route is preferred. We may evaluate Marketplace later for procurement consolidation.

Portal confirmation: https://atlasanalytics.procurementportal.com/confirm?vendor_id=AA-9876-REDWOOD
